description: Cross-check of the QOU 4_1 (HabiroNewtonLadder) and trefoil (AJTrefoil Rosso-Jones) colored-Jones towers against Masbaum arXiv:math/0306345 Thm 5.1 / Rmk 5.2 twist-knot formulas (K_-1 = fig-8, K_1 = left trefoil). Provenance note: the paper is twist knots, not Borromean rings.

data.provenance_correction: math/0306345 = twist knots, NOT Borromean; Borromean ref is Habiro [H1]
data.verdict: Both QOU corpus towers match Masbaum's published twist-knot formulas exactly (40 dps, N<= 7, 4 anchors): the 4_1 Habiro double-Pochhammer tower = J'_{K_-1} (all cyclotomic coefficients 1), and the trefoil Rosso-Jones tower = J'_{K_1} (q_M = 1/q_corpus (mirror)). The trefoil convention is now literature-anchored (Masbaum's left-handed K_1), not merely self-anchored. PROVENANCE: math/0306345 is twist knots, carries NO Borromean formula — the Borromean cross-check needs Habiro [H1], unavailable.
